camps_on_the_main_episode.why_this_matters: The main episode of GRB 160625B is the single most contested spectral-shape target in the campaign so far. Five published readings of the SAME seconds:
camps_on_the_main_episode.A_two_break_synchrotron: Ravasio+2018 - 2SBPL, E_break=107.8 keV, Ep=673.5 keV, >8 sigma over SBPL, and 2SBPL FAVOURED OVER SBPL+BB (i.e. an explicit rejection of the thermal alternative)
camps_on_the_main_episode.B_nonthermal_no_BB: Zhang+2018 - Band / physical synchrotron over 71 slices, thermal component explicitly NOT required
camps_on_the_main_episode.C_thermal_required: Lu+2017 - mBB + CPL: a thermal component IS required in Episode II
camps_on_the_main_episode.D_thermal_plus_cutoff: Wang+2017 - thermal components in some intervals AND a significant tens-of-MeV cutoff, which they warn is acceleration-related rather than gamma-gamma
camps_on_the_main_episode.E_two_break_AND_BB_newest: Aldowma+2026 - DSBPL+BB, Ep=2000 keV, kT=20 keV, dBIC=72 in the peak second 188.45-189.47 s (inside our window), and ISSM+PL over 188.451-214 s
camps_on_the_main_episode.consequence: B and C are flatly contradictory. A rejects the BB against a 2SBPL continuum; E accepts a BB against a DSBPL continuum in a much shorter interval. T7 governs: every one of these verdicts is CONTINUUM- and INTERVAL-relative. Our blind fit must be diffed against each camp separately, with its own continuum and interval named.
